# Npcap SDK

`include/` and `x64/wpcap.lib` are the headers and x86-64 import library from
Npcap SDK 1.16, downloaded from
<https://npcap.com/dist/npcap-sdk-1.16.zip>.

It contains no Npcap runtime or driver. Windows installations use the
`wpcap.dll` and Npcap driver already installed on the target system.
